from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancials(BaseModel):
    """Undistributed profits information for a single company in one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code if available")
    undistributed_profit: float | None = Field(description="The undistributed profits amount for the reported period")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    location: str | None = Field(description="Where in the document this figure appears, e.g., '合并资产负债表/所有者权益'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document containing this value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financials: list[CompanyFinancials]
